title: The Gate to the Field
caption: Sunset. Rick at the gate with his bird; across the field the Sun goes down into Mr McBain's barn.

sun_low.means: how far the Sun has gone down: 0 a hand over the barn's ridge, 1 going into the barn (its foot behind the ridge)

objects.name: The rail fence along the field
